data.title: 间桐樱 · 黑化私密·红黑魔力流转与完全释放
data.description: 红黑魔力翻滚的虚无结界中，黑樱独自悬浮在由她操纵的暗影带上。破碎黑裙停在腰际，令咒纹路沿裸露胸部与腹部发光；两条影带托住大腿并迫使双膝折起，她一手控制影带的轨迹，另一手按在自己腿间感受魔力回流。紫发向上漂散，红瞳含泪却带着清醒而危险的笑。
data.promptProse: Adult Sakura controls two shadow ribbons supporting her thighs with her knees bent, one hand directing them and the other touching herself; her black dress remains at her waist. Red markings glow on her torso as her loose hair floats upward.
data.action: 独自悬浮于自控暗影带上，破碎黑裙停在腰际，一手驾驭影带、一手按向腿间，令咒沿成熟身体发光
data.lighting: 黑化红黑魔力流转辉光与卧室幽暗地灯
data.identityProseOverride: Sakura Matou from Fate/stay night in her dark form, with long purple hair, a red ribbon on her left side and red eyes.
data.animaCaption: Luminous crimson tendrils coil gently in the air, illuminating her captivating, corrupt beauty across the dark room.
